collisions.name: godelian_incompleteness
collisions.structuralImpossibility: A system attempts to fully prove its own consistency; Gödelian incompleteness appears.
collisions.qualifier: Applies to COMPLETE self-reference combined with invariant (paper wording: 'Complete Self-Reference ⊗ Invariant'). The completeness qualifier is data the detector must respect — partial self-reference with invariants is not a collision.
